title: Product noise kernel formula
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive coordinate weights summing to $1$, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the product outcome space. For every product outcome $x$, the product spectral noise operator satisfies $T_\rho f(x)=\sum_y\left[\prod_i\left(\rho\mathbf{1}_{x_i=y_i}+(1-\rho)w_i(y_i)\right)\right]f(y)$, where $w_i$ is the weight on coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite product of n coordinate probability spaces
Real-valued function f on product outcomes
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$ with coordinate weights $w_i$, $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then $T_\rho f(x)=\sum_y[\prod_i(\rho\mathbf1_{x_i=y_i}+(1-\rho)w_i(y_i))]f(y)$ for every $x\in\Omega$.
